caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a metal instrument with a clamp-like end, a rod extending from the clamp, and a circular handle at the opposite end. The main body of the instrument is rendered in shades of brown with hints of purple and blue, capturing the metallic texture. To the lower right of the instrument, there are two simple, separate forms drawn in a light brown or reddish color: a vertical line and an incomplete circle resembling the letter 'C'. The background is plain and light in tone. The name "Elizabeth Johnson" is written in small text near the bottom left corner of the drawing. The composition is spaced out with the instrument occupying the upper left quadrant and the two drawn forms positioned near the lower right.
title: Branding Iron
